name: s-portal-magazine
description: Publish an article as a new cube in the המגזין שלנו magazine on s-portal.co.il: AI cover image, preview, publish on approval. Includes the s-portal Elementor and Cloudways connections.

wp_user.title: WordPress user
wp_user.description: The s-portal.co.il WordPress login the articles are published under

wp_app_password.title: WordPress application password
wp_app_password.description: From wp-admin → Users → Profile → Application Passwords (spaces are fine)

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Used to create the cover images (starts with sk-)

cloudways_token.title: Cloudways access token
cloudways_token.description: Used to clear the site cache after publishing (platform.cloudways.com → API)
